_meta.purpose: Key Opinion Leader (KOL) finder behind Build Your Network (page 1882). Every speciality researched from its main bodies and conference.
_meta.basis: Public-domain information published by the bodies themselves. Lawful basis: legitimate interests (UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f)), limited to name, public role and the page it came from. No contact details are held.
_meta.removal: Anyone listed can ask for removal at contact@elevateandthrive.uk. The name is added to data/contacts-optout.json and dropped at the next build.
_meta.linkedin: A profile link is held only where a public search result showed the same name with a matching role, employer or speciality (the basis is recorded). Everyone else has a search link built from the name and speciality. Nothing is scraped.
